description: Front-desk daily operations: Today home (FD), Classes > Rosters tab with week view, new roster.html, Payments (take payment, outstanding, daily summary, refunds view, mistakes), new equipment.html. Covers R20-R42 (plan.md section 1B). Depends on FEAT-001; independent of FEAT-003 and FEAT-004 except that registration activation (FEAT-003) will push into DB.equipment.
steps: Read FEAT-001 findings and plan.md R20-R42. Read admin_portal/index.html, sessions.html, payments.html, admin.js renderSessions/openSessionForm, instructor_portal/instructor.js classState for the status pattern.

Create admin_portal/admin-desk.js (loaded after admin-shell.js on its pages; runPage map for dashboard, sessions, payments, equipment, followups stubs not needed yet). Implement renderToday(): header 'Today · HQ Dojo · <date>', buttons New registration (links register.html), Take payment, Find student (search opening member.html), Walk-in guest; four .stat cards computed from data; today's sessions timeline using classState with Open roster buttons; 'Waiting on you' rows. No .bars on FD home. index.html keeps a container for the BA Overview that FEAT-004 fills; for BA this step renders the same Today view behind a data-ba switch placeholder only if trivial, otherwise leave BA home as the existing layout until FEAT-004.

sessions.html: rework into tabs (.filters/.fpill) with Rosters tab (day strip, date picker input using the core.js date picker pattern, list of HQ classes: time, instructor, booked/capacity, waitlist, status, Open roster; week view showing spaces left; cancelled days from DB.closures). Leave the existing recurring-class table in a Timetable tab container marked data-ba (FEAT-004 completes it) so the BA page still works. Add DEBUG PANEL placeholder HTML comment for the clock (R34).

Create admin_portal/roster.html (data-page="roster", data-root="../", same shell/script order) and roster logic in admin-desk.js: header, strip (Booked/Checked in/Walk-ins/Waitlist), roster table with access check via whyNotFor and package/dues state, how booked, present/no-show toggle; actions Add walk-in (guests with valid pass only, quick guest record with repeat-trial mobile warning), Book student (eligible only, booking window rules from policies), Cancel booking (credit returned when at least 4 hours before), Waitlist with Offer spot, Submit attendance; correction modal requiring a reason; ineligible/not booked -> FD 'Refer to Business Admin' (push DB.exceptions), BA 'Override with reason' (data-ba); no-show note about MC. State persisted in DB.rosters['<yyyy-mm-dd>|<HH:MM>'], include the demo student's BOOKINGS.

payments.html + admin-desk.js: number cards (Collected today, Outstanding, Processing) computed from DB.ledger; tabs Today, Outstanding (Collect), Daily summary (today's desk payments + total, Submit and lock, PDF via makePDF), BA-only Failed payments tab (data-ba) and refund list (FD view + 'Request refund', BA Approve/Decline); Take payment modal flow: find student, choose item (registration S$60, annual dues S$48, package, grading fee), prices read from DB.policies (read-only), discountFor() applied, method fixed to Stripe (mock desk checkout, no QR, no cash), receipt PDF via makePDF; 'Report a mistake' for FD, void/adjust with reason for BA (data-ba). Keep the search box via filterList. Add DEBUG PANEL placeholder comment for failed Stripe auto-payment.

Create admin_portal/equipment.html + logic: cards To collect / Unpaid orders (no stock, no low-stock); orders table member, item, size (DOGI_SIZES), payment status, status Requested -> Ready at HQ -> Handed over with advance buttons; Mark handed over asks for collector name; no stock tab. Seed DB.equipment in FEAT-001 data (adjust if needed).

Create .admin-fix-tmp/verify/verify-feat2.mjs asserting R20-R42 per plan.md 5.3 (as Admin and Business Admin) with screenshots at 1280 and 390 of index, sessions, roster, payments (with take-payment modal), equipment. Run it plus verify-feat1.mjs and regress.mjs; fix failures. Record findings: DB shapes for rosters/ledger/refunds/equipment, helpers added.
acceptance_criteria: As Admin, Today shows the four stat cards, today's HQ class timeline with statuses and Open roster buttons, and no organisation charts.

roster.html lets Admin book an eligible student (Booked +1), shows 'Refer to Business Admin' for an ineligible student, and BA sees 'Override with reason'; walk-in picker lists only guests with valid passes; a post-submission correction requires a reason.
Cancelling a booking at least 4 hours ahead returns a lesson to the pass in localStorage.

Payments: Take payment completes with Stripe as the only method, adds a ledger row and produces a receipt PDF; daily summary total equals the sum of today's desk rows and Lock prevents re-submission; Admin sees refunds without Approve; Failed payments tab and void/adjust exist only for Business Admin (not in DOM for Admin).
Equipment status moves Requested -> Ready at HQ -> Handed over, and there is no stock or shortage UI.
No horizontal overflow at 390px on index, sessions, roster, payments, equipment; no console errors.
findings: VERIFIED: verify-feat2 104/104, verify-feat1 125/125 (two stale FD assertions updated: #stActive and #stOut became #fdStats and #payStats), regress 17/17. Nothing staged or committed. FILES: new admin-desk.js, roster.html, equipment.html; edited index.html (FD #fdHome + BA #baHome data-ba wrapper; fdHome removed for BA), sessions.html (Rosters tab, BA-only Timetable tab #tabTimetable, DEBUG PANEL comment), payments.html (rewritten, tabs), admin.js (dashboard() returns for FD and targets #baHome; sessions() guarded on #sesRows; payments() removed), portal.css (additive block at end: .main .g3/.g4 > .stat.alert/.dark override of nth-child tints, a.stat, .page-h .acts.wrap, .ag-item.desk, .desk-bar, .row-btn, .acts-inline, .sub-note). GLOBALS in admin-desk.js (load after admin-shell.js): iso, dayIdx, hqClassesOn(date), startAt(date,cls), who(), rosterHref, getRoster/ensureRoster(date,cls), accessOf(row,date,cls)->{s,t}, canBook(member,date,cls), classItem(date,cls), statePill, findMembers(q), memberBtn, takePayment({id|no}), receiptPDF, findStudentModal, walkInModal(date,cls), bookModal, pill(cls,text), uid(prefix), POL(), BOOKING_RULES(). Do not redeclare these names in later admin scripts. DB SHAPES: DB.rosters['YYYY-MM-DD|HH:MM'] = {rows:[{id,no,name,g,how:'Online'|'Desk'|'Walk-in'|'Waitlist offer',status:'booked'|'present'|'noshow',guest?:'G-xx',override?:reason}],waitlist:[{id,no,name}],submitted:Date|null,submittedBy,corrections:[{at,by,who,from,to,reason}]}. Rosters are generated deterministically (about half real members, rest sample names, count = session.booked) and only stored once something changes; the demo student's BOOKINGS appear and vanish via syncMine. Booking Lervyn from the desk pushes BOOKINGS and decrements the pass; cancel at 4+ hours returns the lesson. Members other than Lervyn use m.left. DB.ledger rows may gain note; st may now be 'Voided'. Collect updates the row in place. DB.dailyLocks[YYYY-MM-DD] = {at,by,total,count} (new key, not in SEED). DB.refunds new rows {id,no,name,item,amt,reason,by,at,status}. DB.exceptions rows pushed with kinds access and mistake (BA Exceptions tab in FEAT-003 should show them, ids start X-). DB.equipment rows: status flow Requested, Ready at HQ, Handed over; handedAt and by set; handover blocked when paid is false. DB.guests: trial guests flagged used when they walk in; new guests get G-nn ids. DECISIONS: desk bookings are allowed until the class starts (online needs minDays); payments for packages do not add lessons to the member (mock); discounts apply to registration, dues and packages, not grading fee or dogi; dogi price S$85 is a constant in admin-desk.js because Policies has no dogi price (FEAT-004 may add one); 'Payments needing attention' = Outstanding rows only; FD never sees Failed rows. FEAT-003 TODO: activation should push a DB.equipment row (R42), register.html and member.html links already exist from Today and Find student. FEAT-004 TODO: BA Overview still the old layout in #baHome; BA Timetable tab still uses old openSessionForm. Screens: fd-today/sessions/roster/payments/equipment at 1280 and 390, fd-payments-takepay-1280/390. Verify lib: verify-feat2.mjs helper pattern dateFor(page,type,minAhead) uses in-page dayIdx/iso.
